plan.notes: Official 'Suggested Course Sequence' from Cabrillo College (Spanish AA-T  - Transfer Pathway to CSUMB). Cabrillo labels this 'a suggested sequence of coursework' and notes 'This is not an official educational plan'; sequenced here as the college's published pathway. Credit ranges use the source lower bound: CAL-GETC AREA 2 MATHEMATICAL CONCEPTS AND QUANTITATIVE REASONING: 3-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 5A PHYSICAL SCIENCE: 3-5, lower bound used; SPAN 3 / SPAN 16: 4-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 4 SOCIAL AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES: 3-4, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 5B BIOLOGICAL SCIENCE: 3-5, lower bound used; SPAN 4 / SPAN 17: 4-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 4 SOCIAL AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES: 3-4, lower bound used.
